issues.reason: Coordination & plurals licenses one event with multiple Agent atoms only for a reciprocal/aggregate predicate or a bare "together / jointly / between them" marker — "stop" is neither and no marker is present — so the two Agent atoms on sk_stop_1 violate the distributive default ("many events = distributive; one event with many agents = collective").
The same stated rule is broken again on sk_recover_1, which carries two Agent atoms copied in from the same coordinated controller with no reciprocal/aggregate predicate or collectivity marker.

gaps_confirmed: the implicit subject of a purpose to-infinitive: the connective rule says to reify both clauses and emit (To <main> <purpose>) but never states whether the purpose event inherits the main clause's agent
new_gaps: distributing a COORDINATED CONTROLLER of a control complement: the control rule says to copy the controller's role into the reified complement, and the coordination rule says to replicate the predication per conjunct, but nothing states whether the matrix event also splits or instead carries one Theme atom per complement event

whether an object-control matrix verb keeps its controller as a role-filler of its own ("invite X to V") — the periphrastic-causative precedent puts the object only in the caused event, and no rule settles the control case, so the invitees end up with no matrix role
repair_summary: Split sk_stop_1 into sk_stop_1 (Agent twilight) and sk_stop_2 (Agent sk_friends_1), each with its own Member and the shared Patient sk_eoh_1; split sk_recover_1 the same way into sk_recover_1 / sk_recover_2 with the shared Theme chrysalis; added the second purpose atom (To sk_stop_2 sk_recover_2) and a second Theme on the one invite event so the friends' branch stays attached to the invitation.
notes: The matrix invite was left as one event because no confirmed issue challenges it and the invitees carry no matrix role to distribute over; its two Theme atoms are two distinct eventualities, not a coordinated NP given the collective shape. Object-control routing, the possessed-plural group for "her friends" and the PartOf reading of "the elements of harmony" all stand.
